translation: The Zang Qi Fa Shi Lun (藏氣法時論) says: When the kidney suffers from dryness, urgently eat acrid things to moisten it, to open the interstices (腠理), to bring forth fluids, and to free the qi. Salty can soften hardness; salty is water. Water moistens and is soft, and therefore can overcome the hardness of fire; these are the flavors of the five viscera. That which is the root of the five flavors is blandness (淡).
translator_notes: 藏氣法時論 kept as chapter name; 腠理 rendered 'interstices'; 淡 rendered 'blandness'.
